question: Does learned mean/max answer-group representation improve selection beyond a size-neutral max-score group-CE control, and what is the effect of explicit group size?
candidate_readout: S2 contextual candidate hidden concatenated with mean contextual hidden of all four candidates
group_readout: Within-official-answer-group mean contextual hidden concatenated with within-group coordinatewise max hidden, then shared nonlinear head
shared_backbone: 1024-to128 encoder, FFN128-to256-to128 residual, four-head MHA residual, two LayerNorm; dropout0.1; readout256+6-to64-to1
initialization: Identical state per seed in all six cells; first128 head columns copied from original head, added context/max and six feature columns zero; functions identical within size pairs and CandBCE/CandMaxCE, not across candidate/group pooling on non-singleton groups
features: Six standardized slots, only validity active in NoSize, validity and own-answer-support/4 in Size; all other slots zero AFTER standardization; no new question/candidate evidence
size_caveat: Ablates the explicit support column only. Membership, mean/max and candidate-level attention can retain implicit size/diversity cues; NoSize is not proven size-invariant end-to-end.
grouping: Unchanged official parse_answer; None excluded from groups, still present in shared candidate attention; first-occurrence group ordering, padded to4
scope: Same2114 training questions with >=2 distinct valid numeric answers for every cell; inputs only determine membership and scope
preprocessing: Identical mean/std fitted to all4755 training inputs and six raw features
CandBCE_loss: Question mean of BCE over valid candidates only, so invalid-candidate labels are not extra supervision relative to group CE
CandMaxCE_loss: Group CE of max candidate logit within each official group; no log(size) summation advantage; inference rank equals candidate argmax for a single member
GroupCE_loss: Group CE of learned mean/max group readout; exactly one correct group
sampling: Identical cyclic shuffled2114 question pool and exact draw order across all six cells per seed, retain unconsumed indices
checkpoint: Last budget only, no validation loading during training, no hyperparameter or checkpoint search
inference: One valid group -> first valid candidate without loading assets; zero valid groups -> index0 legal fallback; multi-group -> group scores; within selected group first candidate. All four candidates still participate in the attention backbone.
ensemble: All cells use equal mean of member group softmax probabilities; single-member argmax preserved. This differs from historical sigmoid averaging, so historical740 is context not matched denominator.
primary: GroupCE_NoSize minus CandMaxCE_NoSize, mean over paired seeds then question bootstrap
secondary: Size minus NoSize within each representation
evaluation: 36 fresh official evaluations (five singles+one ensemble per cell), six portable ensemble replays, 10000 paired question bootstrap seed20261018
problem_side_audit: Train-only feasibility screens for original-question explicit x/y/z equations and interest+original/principal wording. Before any hard-rule extension require >=20 supported training questions, manual fidelity audit and no reference contradiction. These narrow screens are not a general semantic parser. If inadequate, record no-go and do not merge unsafe constraints into the group comparison.
limits: Four CPU threads total, no external weights/data/APIs, <=16MiB assets per deployed predictor, official reference30s still requires certification
validation_caveat: Repeated development use; intervals descriptive and conditional on fitted models, no multiplicity correction or fresh-heldout claim
